title: LEAVE THIS PLAYING THROUGHOUT TODAY
text: I want you to open your mouth and begin to worship. Begin to worship. Don't just sit there. Wherever you are in your car, in your kitchen, in your bedroom, on your way to work, open your mouth and release worship right now. Because I have learned that the atmosphere of worship is the birthing room of miracles. When worship goes up, miracles come down. When adoration ascends, captivity is reversed. Worship him. Worship him. Let the worship come from the deepest part of you. Father, we honor you. We honor you, Lord. We bless your name. Worthy are you, Lord God Almighty. Worthy are you. There is no other like you in all the earth. There is no other that compares to your glory, to your power, to your majesty. We worship you, Father. We worship you. Now, settle down. Settle down in your spirit. I need to speak to you for a moment before the fire falls, because fire that falls on ignorance is wasted. Fire that falls on a prepared vessel that changes history. The title of what you are engaging with today is back to sender. And the moment I received this in my spirit, the Lord began to open something to me that I need to share with you. Because there are people engaging with this ministration who have been under a level of spiritual bombardment, and they don't even fully understand where it is coming from. There are people here who have been experiencing unusual losses. Things that should work are not working. Doors that should open are not opening. And in the realm of the spirit, there is an assignment, a deliberate coordinated satanic assignment against your life, your family, your finances, and your destiny. But I have good news for you today. Turn with me to the book of Obadiah chapter 1 and verse 15. Obadiah chapter 1 verse 15 says, "For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen. As thou has done, it shall be done unto thee. Thy reward shall return upon thine own head." Write that down. Let that sink into your spirit. "As thou has done, it shall be done unto thee. Thy reward shall return upon thine own head." This is a kingdom principle that many believers have not fully activated. There is a divine law in the courts of heaven that says whatever the enemy has sent against you, when you rise in spiritual authority and enforce the verdict of the cross, that assignment must return to its sender. Not because you are seeking vengeance, not because you are operating in the flesh, but because you are enforcing a verdict that was already settled at Calvary. Turn also to Esther chapter 9 and verse 1. Esther chapter 9 verse 1. "Now in the 12th month, that is the month Adar, on the 13th day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them." Did you see that? On the very day, on the exact day that the enemies of destiny were expecting to have dominion over God's people, it was turned to the contrary. I decree over you right now whatever the enemy scheduled for this season of your life, whatever coordinated agenda has been planned against your home, your marriage, your children, your business, your body, it is being turned to the contrary in the name of Jesus. Now, let me teach you something. Let me teach you something before we go into warfare. The enemy does not just attack randomly. When the devil assigns something against a believer, he does it through specific channels. And one of the greatest deceptions in the body of Christ is that we think all our problems are natural. We think it is just economics, just circumstances, just bad luck. But the word of God is very clear in Ephesians chapter 6 verse 12. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Your wrestling is not with your boss who keeps frustrating you. Your wrestling is not with that colleague who keeps taking credit for your work. Your wrestling is not with that business competitor. Behind every face of human opposition, there is a spiritual assignment. And until you address the spiritual root, you will keep fighting shadows. Now, here is where it gets prophetic. There are people engaging with this who have unknowingly been targets of deliberate witchcraft, not just vague spiritual opposition. Deliberate, targeted, coordinated spiritual attack. I need you to hear me. I am not preaching fear. I am preaching authority because the man who knows his authority does not tremble, he decrees. First John chapter 4 verse 4 says, "Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world." Greater is he, not equal, not slightly stronger, greater. The one who lives on the inside of every blood washed spirit-filled believer is infinitely greater than every power of darkness that has ever assembled itself against your destiny. >> [music] >> But I need to take you deeper because it is one thing to know you have authority, it is another thing to know how to deploy it. When the Bible speaks of things returning to sender, it is speaking of a spiritual law, the law of divine retribution through covenant. You see, the enemy uses covenants to send his arrows. He uses evil altars to fire arrows against destinies. He uses the blood of animals, the hair of victims, buried objects, coordinated rituals. All of these are methods of creating spiritual channels through which evil can travel to a target. But here is what the enemy does not want you to know. Every arrow has to travel through a medium. And the cross of Jesus Christ is the ultimate barrier. When you activate the blood of Jesus as a covering, when you activate the fire of God as a shield, those arrows cannot penetrate. And not only can they not penetrate, they reverse. Daniel chapter 6, when they threw Daniel into the lions' den, expecting destruction to swallow him, the Bible records that those same lions that they expected to destroy Daniel, when his accusers were thrown in, the lions overpowered them before they even reached the bottom of the den. Back to sender. Back to sender. The same fire that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were thrown into, the men who threw them in were destroyed by that same fire. Back to sender. What the enemy throws at you in this season shall consume the one who threw it. Now, I want to speak to someone very specifically. I am seeing in the realm of the spirit a person you have been having recurring dreams. In this dream, you keep seeing yourself in your place of birth, in your father's compound, in your village, or in a location from your past. And in this dream, there are always people around you, sometimes familiar faces, sometimes strange ones. And when you wake up from that dream, something always feels different. Something feels heavy. Something feels drained. That dream is not ordinary. That is an astral projection, a spiritual raid on your destiny through the access point of familiar spirits. And today by the authority of the name of Jesus, that access is being permanently sealed. I want to speak to another person. Your business, you started it with everything, you invested, you sacrificed, you believed, and at some point it just began to bleed. Money goes in and disappears. Contracts that should close don't close. Partnerships that look promising suddenly collapse. There is an evil altar somewhere, could be in your bloodline, could be in a geographical location from which a spirit of financial hemorrhage has been assigned to you. And today that altar is coming down. Let me give you another scripture. Second Kings chapter 6 verse 16. When Elisha's servant saw the army surrounding the city and began to panic, Elisha said, "Fear not, for they that be with us are more than they that be with them." And then Elisha prayed and said, "Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes that he may see." And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. Listen to me, you are not fighting alone. The angelic hosts of heaven are deployed around every covenant child of God. You are not outnumbered, you are not outmatched. The mountain around your life is full of fire. Fire that the enemy cannot see and cannot defeat. Now today, I'm going to take you through a prayer that will shake the heavens. A prayer that will dismantle every evil altar. A prayer that will reverse every arrow. A prayer that will restore every stolen virtue. A prayer that will cancel every evil covenant. A prayer that will open every sealed door. A prayer that will command angelic intervention into every area of your life. But before we go there, I need you to understand one more thing. Romans chapter 8 verse 31. What shall we then say to these things? If God before us, who can be against us? Who can be against us? Not who is trying to be against us. Not who would dare stand against us. The question is who can? And the answer in the context of that scripture is nobody. No principality. No power, no ruler of darkness, no spiritual wickedness in high places, nobody who sets themselves against a child of God under covenant can prevail. Now, take a deep breath. I need you to enter a place of focused prayer. I need you to rise from wherever you are spiritually. Come out of passivity. Come out of spiritual sluggishness. Come out of the mentality that prayer is a religious ritual that you perform and go back to your normal life. Prayer is war. Prayer is the enforcement mechanism of heaven's verdicts on earth. Matthew chapter 18 verse 18. Verily I say unto you, "Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven." The binding and the loosing that is a legal activity in the spirit realm. When you bind, heaven backs it up. When you loose, heaven enforces it. You are not performing a religious ceremony. You are legislating in the spirit realm. Now, open your mouth. Open your mouth and pray these prayers with your whole heart, your whole voice, and your whole spirit. Father, in the name of Jesus, I enter your presence as a blood washed, spirit filled, covenant child. I stand on the finished work of Calvary. I stand on the blood that was shed at the cross, blood that speaks better things than the blood of Abel, blood that has not lost its power, blood that has not faded in its efficacy, blood that silences every voice of accusation in the heavenly places. I come before your throne with boldness, not the boldness of arrogance, but the boldness of sonship, the boldness of a child who knows their father. Father, I declare that every right that I have in you, I activate in this moment. Now, begin to command every power that has been assigned against my life in this season, I render you powerless in the name of Jesus. Every coordinated satanic agenda against my destiny, I scatter you now by fire in the name of Jesus. Every meeting of darkness convened against me, I command confusion into that meeting right now. Let the agenda of my enemies become confusion. Let their plans become stumbling blocks to themselves. Let the counsel of the wicked against my life come to nothing in the name of Jesus. I take the blood of Jesus and I apply to my mind, to my spirit, to my body, to my home, to my finances, to my relationships, to my marriage, to my children, to my business, to my career, to every area of my life that the enemy has targeted. Now, I speak to every arrow, every arrow of sickness that has been fired against my body, I command you to return to your sender right now in the name of Jesus. You will not land, you will not find a resting place, you will not fulfill your assignment. You are going back. You are going back. You are going back to the one who sent you. In the name of Jesus. Every arrow of financial destruction, every arrow that was fired to drain my resources, to close my doors, to dry up my streams of income, to frustrate my investments, I command you to reverse now. Go back. Go back to the sender in the name of Jesus. And as you go back, take with you the consequences of your assignment. Let poverty rest on the house that sent it. Let lack follow the one who fired it. Let financial collapse return to its origin in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of marital destruction, every arrow fired against my marriage, against my relationship, against my home, against the peace in my household, I destroy you now in the name of Jesus. Go back. Go back. Every spirit of strife, every spirit of disconnection, every spirit of infidelity that was sent against my home, return to your sender right now in Jesus' name. Every arrow of delay, every spirit of postponement, every force of stagnation that has been deployed to keep me tackling the same mountain, I [music] break your assignment now in the name of Jesus. Every embargo on my progress, lift now by fire. Every ceiling on my advancement, shatter now in Jesus' name. I command sudden acceleration into every area of my life. What would have taken 10 years must happen now. What the enemy postponed must manifest suddenly in Jesus' name. I want to speak to someone right now. Your time has come. Your time has come. The delay that you have endured, the years of waiting, the seasons of wondering, the moments of questioning, that season is over. Heaven is not slow concerning his promise to you. Heaven is precise. And what God has promised you is about to break through with a force that will silence every voice that ever doubted you. Now I come against evil altars. Every evil altar that has been erected in my bloodline, I bring it down now by the fire of God. Whether it was erected by my grandfather, my grandmother, through ancestral covenants, through idol worship, through blood sacrifices, I sever every connection between me and that altar right now in Jesus' name. I am not a product of my bloodline curses. I am a product of the blood of Jesus. My ancestry has been rewritten. My genealogy has been changed. I am now in the lineage of the lamb. Every curse that traveled through my bloodline is broken at the cross. Now I speak to the curse. Every curse of poverty in my family line, I break you now in Jesus' name. Every generation that died poor, every generation that worked hard and had nothing to show, every generation where money never stayed, I declare that pattern broken over my life in Jesus' name. I am the generation where the curse ends. I am the generation where the turn around begins. I am the generation where the blessing takes root and does not leave. Every curse of untimely death, every pattern of people in my family dying young, dying prematurely, before their time, I break that pattern over my life and the lives of my children in the name of Jesus. Psalm 91 verse 16, "With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation." That is a covenant promise. Long life satisfied, not cut short, not abbreviated. Long life in Jesus' name. Every curse of marital failure, every pattern of divorce, every pattern of broken homes, every pattern of loneliness and rejection in relationships, I break that pattern now in Jesus' name. I am not my parents' failures. I am not my grandparents' tragedy. I carry the grace of God that is sufficient for my generation. Every witchcraft manipulation over my life and destiny, I destroy you now. I destroy every voodoo. I destroy every juju. I destroy every charm. I destroy every enchantment. I destroy every incantation. I destroy every manipulation whether it came through food, through contact, through objects placed in my environment, through words spoken against me in darkness. I destroy every one of them now in the name of Jesus. Now, I want someone to enter into a different level of prayer. Father, I come against every marine spirit that has been assigned against my life. Every water spirit that has been using the dream realm to steal from me, I command you out now in the name of Jesus. You have no legal right to my life. You have no legal right to my body. You have no legal right to access my destiny through the waters. I dry up every evil river that flows toward me in the spirit realm. I command the waters of witchcraft to become a desert in the name of Jesus. Every sexual demon that has been attacking me in the dream realm, every spirit spouse, every incubus, every succubus, I divorce you now in the name of Jesus. Every evil soul tie that was created through those encounters in the night, I sever every one of them now by the blood of Jesus. I am no longer connected to you. I do not carry your mark. I [music] do not carry your assignments. I am free in the name of Jesus. I command every stolen item to be returned. Every virtue that was stolen from me, return now in the name of Jesus. Every glory that was hijacked, return now. Every opportunity that was diverted, return now. Every door that was shut through witchcraft, open now. Every relationship that was scattered through evil manipulation, every godly relationship, every divine connection, I restore it now in the name of Jesus. Now, I speak to time. Father, I know that time is a resource that the enemy attacks. I know that there are seasons that were stolen. I know that there are years that the locust has eaten. But your word in Joel chapter 2 verse 25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." You said you would restore the years, not just the days, not just the weeks, the years. Father, I claim this covenant right now. Restore every year that was stolen. Restore every season that was eaten. Restore every opportunity that was missed because of spiritual attack. Restore it. Restore it. Restore it, Lord, in Jesus' name. I am speaking to someone right now who feels like they are behind, like everyone else is moving and you are standing still, like your mates have overtaken you, like what you were supposed to have achieved by now has not happened. I need you to hear heaven speaking over you. You are not behind. You are on a divine schedule. And what God is about to do in your life in this coming season will make up for every year, every season, every month, every day that felt like a waste. The God who compressed the Red Sea crossing into one night, he can compress 10 years of progress into one moment. The God who turned Joseph's 13 years of slavery and imprisonment into a single day of exaltation, he is the same God that is watching over your case. Your story is not over. Your best chapter has not been written yet. Now, I want you to enter into family deliverance. Father, I stand in the gap for my family. I lift up my household before you right now. Every member of my family who is under spiritual attack, I cover them with the blood of Jesus right now. My father, my mother, my siblings, my spouse, my children, my extended family, I cover them. I cover them. I cover them with the blood of the lamb. Every arrow that has been fired against my children, I command it to fail now. In the name of Jesus. My children are not targets. They are not victims. They are arrows in the hand of a mighty God. Psalm 127:4. They are sharp arrows. They are arrows that hit their target. Every agenda of the enemy against the next generation in my family, I destroy it now in Jesus' name. Every child in my family who has been captured by the spirit of addiction, by the spirit of rebellion, by the spirit of error, by the spirit of premature death, I pull them back now in the name of Jesus. I pull them back from the edge of destruction. I pull [music] them back from every evil path. I loose the spirit of salvation, the spirit of wisdom, the spirit of understanding over every young person in my family in the name of Jesus. Every marriage in my family that is under attack, I cover it now. I speak stability. I speak love that does not fail. I speak unity. I speak divine chemistry. I speak the grace to endure, the wisdom to navigate, the love that covers a multitude of sins over every marriage in my family in Jesus' name. Every parent in my family who is suffering, who is sick, who is in lack, I command a supernatural turn around right now. Father, remember the covenant. Remember the covenant you made with your servant. Let it benefit every member of my household in Jesus name. Now, I come against the spirit of death. I cover every member of my family with the blood of Jesus against sudden death, against accidents, against untimely departure. The angel of death has no assignment in my household. Exodus chapter 12 verse 23, when the blood was on the doorpost, the destroyer could not enter. I apply the blood now on the doorpost of my home, on the doorpost of my life, on the doorpost of every relationship I carry. The destroyer cannot enter. The destroyer is refused access in the name of Jesus. Now, let me shift into decree over your finances. I decree supernatural financial restoration. Every stream of income that was dried up by spiritual attack, flow again now in the name of Jesus. Every business that died prematurely be resurrected in the name of Jesus. Every investment that was frustrated begin to yield in Jesus name. Every door of financial opportunity that was shut by witchcraft, I command it to open now by the fire of God. I speak to every debt. Every legitimate debt in your life, I speak supernatural speed of repayment. I speak divine strategies for wealth creation. I speak ideas that are worth millions. I speak connections that open financial doors. I speak favor with people in high places. Proverbs 22 verse 29 says, "Seest thou a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings. He shall not stand before mean men." You shall stand before kings. You shall not stand before mean men. The people who once ignored you will come looking for you. The opportunities that once passed you by will return and find you. The deals that fell through will be reopened. I speak sudden financial acceleration. I speak supernatural increase. I speak that you are entering a phase where God will do exceedingly abundantly above what you can ask or think. Ephesians 3:20. Now, I need you to open your mouth and shout. Shout a warfare shout. Open your mouth and give a shout of spiritual warfare right now. Don't be silent. The walls of Jericho didn't fall silently. They fell when the shout went up. Open your mouth. Shout. Shout. Shout. And now I speak to every battle over your health. Every cancer, I command you to wither from the root in the name of Jesus. You did not come from God and you have no right to stay. I speak to every tumor, dissolve now. I speak to every chronic condition, be reversed now. I speak to every diagnosis that doctors call irreversible. Nothing is irreversible with God. 1 Peter chapter 2:24. Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree that we being dead to sins should live onto righteousness. By whose stripes you were healed. Were healed, past tense. The healing is done. The price was paid. The receipt is in heaven. Every sickness is paying illegal rent on a body that belongs to God. I command it to vacate now in Jesus' name. Every virus, every infection, every inflammation, every degenerative condition, I speak the word of the Lord against you. You must bow. You must bow to the name that is above every name. At the name of Jesus, every knee shall bow. Philippians 2:10. And that includes the knee of sickness. I declare healing now. I declare wholeness now. I declare restoration of every organ, every tissue, every cell, every nerve in the name of Jesus. your body is responding to heaven's decree right now. What doctors said could not improve is improving right now. What was declared terminal is meeting the God of resurrection. There is life in your body by the spirit of God. Romans 8:11, "But if the spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwelling you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his spirit that dwelleth in you." The same spirit, the same spirit that raised Jesus from the dead, that same resurrection power is quickening your mortal body right now. You are not dying, you are living. You shall live and not die. You shall declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118:17. Now, I want to speak into the realm of divine connection and destiny. There are people that God has programmed into your life, divine connectors, destiny helpers, angels in human flesh, and the enemy has been working to ensure you never cross paths with these people. I am breaking that satanic embargo right now. In the name of Jesus, every divine connection that was delayed, I command a sudden convergence. The people you are supposed to meet, you will meet them. The doors they carry will be opened. The resources they steward will come to you. The relationships that are tied to your next level, I command them to manifest in this season. In the name of Jesus. I am speaking to someone right now who has been praying for a specific divine connection, a business partner, a spouse, a mentor, a financier, a key person that holds the next chapter of your story. Heaven knows who that person is. Heaven knows where they are. And I decree the path between you and that person is being cleared right now. Every demonic roadblock, every spiritual hindrance, every witchcraft manipulation that has been keeping you apart, I destroy it now in Jesus' name. You will meet, you will connect, and when you do, it will be undeniable. Now, let me speak to someone specifically about marriage. You have been waiting, you have been praying, you have been wondering why it has not happened. You have watched people younger than you get married, you have attended weddings and cried on the inside. You have smiled on the outside but carried pain in your heart. And in your weakest moments, you began to wonder if something was wrong with you. There is nothing wrong with you, you are not cursed, you are not rejected by God, you are being protected, and what God is preparing for you is not less than what others have, it is greater. It is richer, it is deeper, it is more aligned with your destiny than anything you could have chosen for yourself. But before that happens, today I am breaking every evil vow, every spirit spouse, every witchcraft embargo over your marriage in the name of Jesus. Every spirit that has been sitting on your marital destiny, I pull you down now in the name of Jesus. Every incantation that was spoken against you finding love, I destroy it. Every ritual that was performed to keep you alone, I nullify it now by the blood of Jesus. And I speak into your future, your spouse exists, your spouse is real, your spouse is coming. And when they arrive, you will know. God will confirm it. And what he joins together, no man, no devil, no witch, no wizard shall put asunder. Now, I want to speak to the unmarried and also to the married. For those who are married and your home is under attack, I speak to your marriage right now. Peace be still. I speak the peace of God that surpasses understanding, Philippians 4:7 into your home, into your bedroom, into your conversations. I speak healing to every wound that was inflicted by words. I speak restoration to every broken trust. I speak the spirit of forgiveness, the spirit of patience, the spirit of love that does not keep a record of wrongs. 1 Corinthians 13:5. And I destroy every third party that the enemy has introduced into your marriage. Every strange person, every strange voice, every strange influence, I cast them out of your marriage right now in the name of Jesus. Your marriage will not fail. Your home will not collapse. What God put together, he will sustain. Now, I want you to come to a deeper level of spiritual warfare. Father, I take authority over principalities and powers over my geographical location. Every territorial spirit that has been assigned against the region where I live, I bind you now in the name of Jesus. I release the kingdom of God over my city, over my neighborhood, over my community. Let the influence of darkness be broken. Let the strongholds of wickedness be pulled down. Let light come. Let the glory of God fill my environment. Let people in my community encounter Jesus. Let revival break out. And now I pray for breakthrough. Father, I am tired of almost. I am tired of nearly. I am [music] tired of close but no cigar. I am commanding a complete, total, undeniable breakthrough into my life right now. Every door that is on the verge, open now. Every promise that is about to be fulfilled, manifest now. Every blessing that is at the door, enter now. I am not closing this prayer without something shifting. Something is shifting. Something is moving. The atmosphere is changing. Somebody shout breakthrough right now. Shout it. Shout breakthrough. Now I prophesy. I see a financial turnaround coming to someone engaging with this and it is coming in such an unusual way. It is not going to come through the channel you have been expecting. God is going to surprise you. He is going to open a door you never knocked on. He is going to send resources through a person you never expected. He is going to give you an idea that will generate wealth beyond what you have asked for. And when it comes you will know this is not man. This is God. I see healing coming to a body. Someone who has been suffering for a long time, a prolonged sickness, something that has defied medical explanation. Heaven is touching that body right now. Put your hand on that area of your body. Put your hand on it. And I speak be healed in the name of Jesus. The power of God is flowing through that part of your body right now. The inflammation is going. The pain is leaving. The malfunction is being corrected by the hand of the almighty. Receive your healing. Receive it. It is yours. It was bought at Calvary and it belongs to you. I see someone who has been living in fear. A spirit of fear has been tormenting you. Fear of the future, fear of failure, fear of sickness, fear of death. Fear that grips you at night and doesn't let you sleep. Second Timothy 1:7, "For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." That spirit did not come from God. It is an intruder. It is an illegal occupant. And I cast it out right now in the name of Jesus. You are evicted. Spirit of fear, you are evicted from this life. You are evicted from this mind. You are evicted from this home. Go in the name of Jesus. And in your place I release power, love and a sound mind. Power to face every challenge. Love that drives out fear. A sound mind that is stable, that is clear, that is at peace. 1 John 4:18, there is no fear in love, but perfect love casteth out fear. The love of God is casting out your fear right now. Now, I want to address something very deep. There are people engaging with these who made a vow at some point in their life, a promise, a commitment, and it was not fulfilled. And because of that unfulfilled vow, there is a spiritual consequence that has been affecting your life. Whether you made that vow in church, whether you made it in a moment of desperation, whether it was a vow your parents made on your behalf, I speak to the consequences of every unfulfilled vow. Father, have mercy. Cleanse by the blood of Jesus. Remove every consequence that has been flowing from uncompleted covenants, and allow this child of God to walk in freedom in Jesus' name. And for those who have been involved in secret societies, cult memberships, oath taking, covenant with darkness at any point in your life, knowingly or unknowingly, I sever every cord right now. I cut every rope. I break every chain. I nullify every oath. By the authority of the name of Jesus and the power of his blood, I declare you free. You are no longer bound. You are no longer obligated. The blood of Jesus has spoken a better word, and the verdict is freedom. Galatians 5:1, stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage. Stand fast in liberty. This is not a liberty you begged for. This is a liberty that was purchased. Stand in it. Walk in it. Refuse to be entangled again. Now, I want to do one final major sweeping prayer, a comprehensive sweep. In the name of Jesus, I address every evil covenant affecting my progress. I [music] break it. I annul it. I declare it null and void. In the name of Jesus, I address every limitation placed on me by familiar spirits, every boundary the enemy drew around my destiny saying this far and no further. Angels of the Lord, go into the heavenly realm and retrieve everything that belongs to me that the enemy has stolen. Bring it back. Bring it back. Let nothing be missing. In the name of Jesus, I address every reinforcement the enemy is trying to bring against my life. Every time the enemy sends reinforcement against me, I command that reinforcement to be captured and consumed by heavenly fire. Every backup plan of darkness against my destiny fail now. In the name of Jesus, I pray for supernatural speed, speed of fulfillment, speed of manifestation, speed of harvest. What I have planted in tears, let me reap in speed. What I have sown in faith, let me harvest in abundance. Let the harvesting angel arrive at the field of my life, and let there be a supernatural gathering of everything that belongs to me in Jesus' name. Now, Father, I ask for angelic reinforcement. I release the angels of God into every area of my life right now. Hebrews 1:14. Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
